knownServerLimitations: WsgiDAV 4.3.5 recognizes DAV:name instead of RFC4918 DAV:propname; standard propname yields malformed href-only response and is rejected.
Fresh HEAD Digest authentication returns an illegal response body on 401 with Cheroot 11.1.2; Node rejects HTTP framing. Authentication tests use GET; warmed HEAD is tested.
